native_result.query: Between which two races is the factor of BA degree completion -0.9568 when compared to the other?
native_result.HypoA: There is a racial differential in BA degree completion rates between Black and White students with a factor of -0.9568.
native_result.HypoB: Between Hispanic and White respondents, the factor (log-odds coefficient) of BA degree completion is approximately -0.9568 when Hispanic is compared against the White baseline: logistic regression of BA completion (0/1) on race with White as reference gives Hispanic coefficient -0.9241 (odds ratio ~0.40), the closest match to -0.9568 among candidate pairs (Black vs White = -1.0057, |Δ|=0.049). Negative sign = Hispanic substantially less likely than White to complete a BA (1.44% vs White 3.54%; Black 1.33%). Exact source value not 4-decimal reproducible from this sample (rare event); Hispanic-White is the closest data-grounded pair.
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded data/nls_ses_processed.csv; dropped stray row-index column; confirmed 0 missing (no imputation). Inspected race counts and BA completion by race. Fitted headline binary logit: BA DEPENDENT ~ race dummy (ref=White); report coefficients, odds ratios, CI, pseudo-R2. Robustness: logit/probit/LPM across references White/Black/Hispanic. Decision rule: exact -0.9568 not reproduced; selected race pair with minimum |Δ| among negative White-referenced coefficients (Hispanic -0.9241, Δ=0.0327 vs Black -1.0057, Δ=0.0489). Study-context fact noted but not used in the race->BA logit. Script: analysis/run_analysis.py.

sub_hypo.text: Hispanic respondents are substantially less likely than White respondents to complete a BA. With White as the reference, logistic regression estimates a Hispanic coefficient of -0.9241 (odds ratio approximately 0.40), the closest negative White-referenced coefficient to the target -0.9568, which is not exactly reproduced in this sample.
sub_hypo.context: NLS participants in the processed sample, focusing on Hispanic versus White respondents, with Black versus White used as a candidate comparison.
sub_hypo.relations: Binary logistic regression of BA completion (0/1) on race with White as reference yields a Hispanic log-odds coefficient of -0.9241 (odds ratio approximately 0.40). BA completion rates are 1.44% for Hispanic, 3.54% for White, and 1.33% for Black respondents. Hispanic versus White is closest to the target coefficient -0.9568: absolute difference 0.0327 versus 0.0489 for Black versus White (coefficient -1.0057). The exact target is not reproducible to four decimal places in this rare-event sample.
